summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared/auth hash helpers to @fxa/shared/crypto
description:
Because:
- The hex and hash helpers sit in fxa-shared, which is moving to Nx libs.
- libs/shared/crypto already serves fxa-auth-server.

This commit:
- Adds hex and hash to libs/shared/crypto and exports them.
- Ports the four mocha cases to jest and adds a known-answer SHA-256 check.
- Changes 16 auth-server files and access-token.ts to import @fxa/shared/crypto.
- Deletes packages/fxa-shared/auth and test/auth.
- Removes the ./auth and ./auth/* package exports.

Closes FXA-10650
